items.title: Apache Patches Critical Bug Found by Anthropic Scanner
items.summary: The flaw can let unauthenticated attackers run code on HTTP/2-enabled servers.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $2.35B in two weeks as BlackRock’s losing streak hits 11 sessions
items.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $185.4 million in net outflows Friday, with BlackRock’s IBIT accounting for $143.5 million and Fidelity’s FBTC shedding $41.9 million.

items.title: Meta tests prediction-market app, DOJ moves to seize $1.2 billion from Binance hack, and more
items.summary: In today's newsletter, Meta tests prediction-market app using points instead of cash; DOJ moves to seize $1.2 billion from Binance hack, disrupts North Korean deepfake scheme; and more.
